title: Targeted Data Generation: Finding and Fixing Model Weaknesses

bias_targets.methodology: Automatically identifying generic underperforming sub-populations of data by clustering the target model's internal representations (task-based clustering) to discover high-error subgroups, and estimating their expected generalization and interference in context.

Evaluating model weaknesses on specific semantic and linguistic patterns—such as formal versus casual tone differences, factivity, monotonicity, and mixed sentiment dominance—that emerge from the automatic clustering of dataset errors.
